assistant_open_approval_waiting: Assistant: an action waits for your approval
assistant_setup_body: Choose a model server and a model in Settings to start chatting.
assistant_key_saved: A key is saved. Type a new one to replace it.
assistant_web_presets_hint: On web no key is stored. Use a local server, or point Custom at your own proxy.
assistant_context_window_invalid: Enter a whole number of tokens.
assistant_base_url_invalid: Start the address with http:// or https:// and include the server name.
assistant_base_url_needs_https: Use https:// for a server outside your own network. http:// works only for local servers.
assistant_notes_hint: What the assistant remembers about you
assistant_notes_empty: No notes yet. Ask the assistant to remember something.
assistant_notes_error: The notes could not be loaded.
assistant_answer_only: This model cannot use the app's actions. It answers from what is on screen.
assistant_limit_max_steps: Stopped: this reply took too many steps.
assistant_limit_token_budget: Stopped: this reply used up its token budget.
assistant_limit_repeated_call: Stopped: the assistant kept repeating an action.
assistant_limit_output: Stopped: the reply reached the model's output limit.
assistant_empty_body: Ask about what is on screen, or ask me to do something in the app.
assistant_inspector_empty: Nothing to show yet. Send a message first.
assistant_receipt_unverified: Not confirmed: the app could not read this change back.
assistant_error_connection: Can't reach the model server. Check that it is running and that its address in Settings is right.
assistant_error_timeout: The model server stopped responding. Try again.
assistant_error_auth: The model server refused the API key. Check the key in Settings.
assistant_error_not_found: The model or the server address was not found. Check both in Settings.
assistant_error_rate_limit: The model server is busy or the usage limit was reached. Wait a moment, then try again.
assistant_error_server: The model server had a problem. Try again.
assistant_error_request: The model server refused the request. Check the model settings.
assistant_error_bad_reply: The model server sent a reply the app could not read. Check the server address in Settings.
empty_items_hint: Items you or the assistant add show up here.
assistant_model_hint: The model's name as the server lists it, such as llama3.2.
assistant_not_ready_body: The assistant needs a model before it can answer.
on_device_use_server_hint: The model server answers every message.
on_device_web_off: This app does not run the model on the web.
on_device_download_body: It needs {size} of space. Wi-Fi is recommended.
on_device_delete_body: This frees {size}. To use it again, you need to download it again.
on_device_delete_body_only: This frees {size}. The assistant cannot answer until you download it again.
on_device_use_hint: Once its model is ready, this device answers. Until then, the model server does.
on_device_use_needs_server: Set up a model server to choose between them.
on_device_offer_title: Run the assistant on this device
on_device_offer_body: Download {model} ({size}) so the assistant works offline and your messages stay on this device. Wi-Fi is recommended.
on_device_unsupported: This device cannot run the on-device assistant.
on_device_no_memory: Not enough memory on this device.
on_device_download_failed: The download failed. Check the connection and free space, then retry.
on_device_memory_failed: The model did not fit in memory last time.
on_device_load_failed: The model on this device could not start.
on_device_leave_body: This conversation was answered on this device. Continue with {server}? The whole conversation will be sent to it.
assistant_error_device: The model on this device had a problem. Try again.
receipt_use_device: The model on this device answers
